test_coverage_notes: The invariant checks are typically tested in the rippled codebase under unit tests for invariants and NFT logic. Look for test files such as 'test/invariant/NFTInvariant_test.cpp', 'test/app/tx/NFToken_test.cpp', or similar. These should cover cases like invalid page links, empty or oversized pages, unsorted NFT IDs, and invalid URIs. Gaps may exist in edge cases (e.g., malformed links, simultaneous multiple errors, or rare boundary conditions like deleting the final page). Integration tests may also exercise these invariants indirectly via transaction application. Direct fuzzing or property-based tests for all bitmask edge cases may be limited.

validates: Ensures only NFTOKEN_PAGE entries are processed
Previous page link must match owning account
Previous page link must be strictly less than current page (ordering)
Next page link must match owning account
Next page link must be strictly greater than current page (ordering)
NFTokenPage must not be empty (unless being deleted)
NFTokenIDs in the page must be sorted
